chunks: And when I am sick, He heals me.

key_terms.مَرِضْتُ: I was sick / I fell ill

ai.seo_question: Who heals a person when they are sick according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is frequently recited during the 'Wada' al-Quran' ceremony and is central to the concept of Tawassul, where believers seek healing through the intercession of the Prophet and Imams as agents of God's will. It underscores the balance between taking practical means (Asbab) and recognizing Allah as the ultimate Shafi (Healer), a theme elaborated in tafsirs such as Al-Mizan. The verse also highlights the spiritual dimension of illness as a test and a means of purification, encouraging patience and reliance on Divine Mercy.
